## Summary

Describe the user-visible and internal changes.

## Validation

- [ ] `./scripts/test.sh`
- [ ] `./scripts/validate.sh`
- [ ] `./scripts/smoke.sh`
- [ ] `node scripts/test_public_site.mjs` when browser assets change
- [ ] `./scripts/sync-site.sh` when served web files change

## Review boundaries

- [ ] Uses fictional data only
- [ ] Preserves human review and manual-only delivery
- [ ] Does not infer protected traits or diagnose people
- [ ] Does not add covert manipulation, deceptive urgency, or dependency goals
- [ ] Documents data retention, security, API, and compatibility impact
- [ ] Updates public artifacts and changelog when behavior changes
